nom: PEACH & LILY Super Oasis Concentrated Serum

avis.texte: Purchased this serum because of its mix of hyaluronic acid, polyglutamic acid, beta glucan, and snow mushroom extract. It has a pleasant texture, somewhere between a full-bodied liquid and a light gel. It has been helping keep my face hydrated, though I do use other hydrating products alongside. It also feels very gentle and has caused no irritation.

For a while I used it only at night, which did make a difference. But then on a trip, under different lighting, I realized my Bare Minerals tinted moisturizer actually made my skin look older (I am 46) and so I dropped it, decided to try adding a morning application of this Peach & Lily Oases along with the evening application I was already doing--WOW. The 2x a day made a HUGE difference. This oases serum combined with La Roche Vitamin C serum in morning and Peach & Lily Retinol at night made my skin look young again, much better than it had looked with foundation even, so that I will probably not even buy another tinted moisturizer.

I have purchased this so many times. It is great for my sensitive and dry skin. It feels so hydrating and gives my skin that glass skin look without looking too wet. My skin feels and looks smoother too.

I love this serum! I have sensitive, acne-prone, combo skin (leans more dry) and this serum does not irritate it at all. My skin feels soft and plump and I do notice a glow to it after using this serum. I have used this with both the Glass Skin Moisturizer and the Matcha Cream and both work well with this. Highly recommend!

This is my favorite hydrating serum. It's very lightweight and yet super hydrating. I pair it with the Glass Skin Water-Gel Moisturizer and they work perfectly together. My skin is dehydrated and sensitive, prone to breakouts from silicones and oils. And these two products are a holy grail for my skin. Highly recommend to everyone!
My skin was always really dry, this has made a huge difference. My skin feels softer and pores look smaller.

I got the mini as part of the antiaging set. I lovd it. I can habd sensitive skin grom rosacea and this never irritated my skin. The downside is its very expensive. Not saying I won't buy it, but might see of it goes on sale.

Sometimes in the winter after washing my face, my skin has white flakiness and can feel tight. I've never tried a dry skin serum before because I was afraid it would trigger oiliness (I have normal to combination skin), however so far it has not been an issue! Skin feels plump afterwards and tops off well with my Cerave moisturizer. I also don't feel the need to have to use this often, seems to keep my skin in control for a while.

avis.titre: Thick but light for good hydration
avis.texte: I just started this one a few weeks ago but so far I love the hydration. I only use it at night to restore my skin from the days activities. Haven't noticed too much of a difference in my pores but it's still early days. The formula is thick but still light on the skin.
Love these products! My face already feels so refreshed and moisturized. Would definitely repurchase this item. Smells great and love the consistency / color of the products.

I suffered from really dry skin early postpartum, my usual P&L regimen just wasnt cutting it. My skin was begging for something more. This was it! I noticed a difference within 24 hours. Will continue to use, even though i feel like my skin had balanced out. Im in love with this serum! Recommend!!
A luxurious serum! The smell of it is a little different but not bad. My skin feel so silky and soft after using it.

Second time buying this product. I really like it. I was using the Dermalogica circular hydration serum previously, and I loved it but this product is extremely similar and much cheaper. This product hydrates my skin without causing breakouts!
A must have for the harsh winters when my skin gets extremely dry. This serum keeps my skin hydrated and glowing. Definitely a miracle product.

This serum is so hydrating and gives my skin a huge boost of moisture and plumpness. I have dry/sensitive skin and had no issues with it. It feels so smooth and cooling when applying. I also like that it's thicker than a typical serum.
The best serum for dry skin that need moisture! It moisturizes my face leaving it smooth, soft, and looking so rejuvenated!
I love all of the Peach and Lily products I've purchased thus far and the concentrated serum is great for adding moisture to my dry skin.
Staple on my routine. Its lush and makes my skin feel well hydrated.
I love everything about this serum. I have used serums from Peach and Lily for a long time, and this one is amazing! It hydrates and gives me a beautiful glow. I would 100% recommend.

The oasis serum is a formula packed with the most hydrating skincare ingredients. I have a combination to normal skin and it hydrates really well. I love the 14. 5% glycerin in it and the aquaporin. I love using it in the AM on a slightly damp face. It hydrates really well. It doesn't cause any breakouts.
I cannot be without this stuff. Makes my skin feeling super moisturized. I am on my 3rd bottle and recommend this to anyone I know with dry skin.

My skin is crazily sensitive and it is so rare for me to find products that not only not irritate it but actually feel SO PLEASANT to apply. My skin is simply HAPPY when this lightweight (but not too lightweight!) product is applied. I find it particularly good for my mornings. I use several Peach & Lily products but this one is probably the one I use the most often, a good all-rounder.
I have extremely dry skin and this has been a game changer. I've tried countless of moisturizers and this has been the only thing that actually works
Feeling dehydrated recently in the heat; this instantly hydrated and plumped up my skin.

No complaints. The product does as described. My skin has never been so hydrated before, and although the serum is on the thicker side it doesn't break me out. I noticed my usually oily t-zone isn't as oily either. I use it in conjunction with the Glass Skin Refining Serum, love the results I'm getting from using them both.

avis.titre: Best hydrating serum for all day moisture.
avis.texte: Makes a visible difference in the effectiveness of my routine. I use day and night (with Retinol For All Serum), and it's really kicked up my glass skin game!

This was recommended to me by an associate at ulta as my skin was drying out and flaking randomly. After a few days this product turned my skin around and it feels better than its felt in a long time! 100% recommend!

I recently added the Peach & Lily Super Oasis Serum to my skincare routine and it's been great! I use this serum between my toner and moisturizer and it's definitely helped keep my dry skin more hydrated. I've enjoyed Peach & Lily products overall, and this has been a nice addition.

avis.titre: I would use this product again and again
avis.texte: I asked a customer service rep at the Portage store for suggestions on a good hydrating serum. I'm very impressed with the results from this product.

Love this super hydrating serum! When I layer it under moisturizer and an oil, my skin looks dewy and feels silky, and the effects last. I like to rotate this serum with the retinol or lactic acid serums, to comfort and hydrate the skin.

I've tried so much products for my dehydrated skin since the climate where I'm living is really dry, and this is an incredible discovery. Only 2 pumps make my skin feel amazing, it looks plumpy and radiant ! It's a bit sticky on the face, but it disappears after a few minutes. Will repurchase for sure !

I have genuinely never found anything i love more than this serum in terms of skincare. I have very senstive dry, acne prone skin and i am plagued with clogged pores and texture. When i tell my skin has never looked or felt better i mean it. Its so hydrating, not sticky and my skin is so clear!!

avis.titre: Great for when your skin is very dehydrated
avis.texte: Super hydrating and gives you that glass skin look. Great for when your face is super dehydrated

Just didn't really do anything. I was hoping this would fix my extremely dry skin but honestly if I didn't use this product i'd have the same result. I used the whole bottle and noticed absolutely no changes to my skin. Disappointing considering how much I love all peach and lily products. Sadly wont be repurchasing.

I don't notice a very big difference in using this versus other serums. I have very dry, sensitive, eczema prone skin with redness and I found this to flare up my skin once in a while and did not always help hydrate. I find that the glass skin serum works better for me on what the product is intended for. Personally won't repurchase but think the formula could work for other skin types
I use this product priot to using the ultra plush moisturizer! When i apply this i let it lock in for a few min. Then apply the moisturizer! Amazing!!! Glass skin! Worth every dollar.
I've enjoyed the serum with the vitamin C. Once I read how to apply appropriately, I feel moisturized all day🤗
Love how this hydrates! I also use only neck and chest to keep wrinkles away!
I like it because it helps the texture of my skin and make it feel moisturize and not dry or sticky
I've been using this product now off and on for about a year and I really love it. It makes my skin feel really soft and moisturized. It is something that I buy often.

I love this serum. It's very hydrating and gives my face a nice boost. It's an almost gel like consistency, but it goes on so smooth and absorbs quickly. I always feel refreshed and I feel like it helps wake up my dry and tired skin. It makes my skin feel supple and smooth. I've bought this a few times now so it's a regular in my skincare routine. I have really sensitive skin too but it does not irritate it at all.
I love this product so much. I have dry skin and I use it has my primer. My face looks flawless every time!

Its 14% glycerin and with 5 types hyaluronic acids plus ginseng and cherry! This plumos my skin ljke no other! I have super dry skin and I need a hydration serum to go above and beyond and this always delivers!

I ordered the full sized serum after trying it out in the hydration set. My skin was SO dry from the wickedly cold winds we had in January and I was willing to deviate from my usual glass skin serum. This is now my favourite Peach and Lily product. I went for afacial recently and the esthetician said my skin was in amazing condition. I wish (hint hint) you would sell the serum in a trave/minil size like you do for the Glass Skin serum. The full sized bottle is a little heavy and bulky for travel.
I like this serum and the formula but it's quite sticky. I like putting it on wet skin but the stickiness stays, so I like using it as a lip mask.
I originally got this serum in a hydrating kit. It has become a part of my regular routine! I love the way my face looks, feels, and remains moisturized all day!

I absolutely love the intense hydration this cream provides! With the powerful combination of glycerin, hyaluronic acid, my skin feels instantly refreshed and plumped. It protects my skin, leaving it dewy, glowing, and super hydrated. The hydration lasts for hours, and my skin has never felt more nourished. Highly recommend for anyone looking for long-lasting moisture!"
Using this serum everyday ok my face and neck has worked wonders for my skin! It provides a dewy hydrated glow before i start putting on my primer and makeup.

avis.titre: My Favorite Peach and Lily Serum
avis.texte: Absolutely great hydrating serum. It absorbs well and doesn't leave any sticky residue. I pair it with Glass Skin Gel Moisturizer and they work perfectly together. My skin is super picky and this serum didn't give me any clogged pores or breakouts, so it's another win from Peach and Lily!
I've been using this product for a couple weeks and have noticed my pores are less defined which leads to smoother looking skin.

Unbelievable! I'm 47 and my skin is transformed. 'I use this first, then I slather plush cream over it, wait five minutes and put the beam oil on top and I literally have people stop me in stores asking me about my skincare. I'm in love!
This is very hydrating and does not affect my sensitive skin. I love it and would highly recommend.
I am nearing 50 and have extremely dry skin. This serum is a MUST for dry mature skin.
Love this serum - goes on nicely. Just started using so I'll know more of its effect in couple months but so far really nice
I loooove this serum. It goes on so smoothly and leaves my skin so soft. I use it with the plush cream and my skin is so glowy.
I have tried to swap this out for more affordable options and my skin immediately jumps back to super dry. Definitely worth the price.

I am so impressed! My dry, red, barrier impaired skin was HEALED after 1 week of use. My skin is smooth, dewy, and most importantly… not red for the first time in my adult life. I truly feel like this is a miracle product. If these results persist, I will be using this product for life!
This serum is wonderful. I use it AM/PM, and have seen a huge improvement in my skin. It's soft and moisturized, which is rare for this time of year where I live. I highly recommend this product.
This is a moisturizer game changer for my skin! Looking at the selection of other serums it really makes a difference. And it's not even close to acid like!

I've LOVES this product!! More than the glass skin serum when it first came out. I have not felt this moisturized in ages!!! It surprisingly also has helped with my acne healing faster! A little bit goes a long way and it does take a little bit getting used to feeling so hydrated!

I was recommended this product after asking a beauty advisor for a recommendation because i have been using lancome genefique serum for years and im not sure it was doing anything for my skin that could justify the price. She immediately showed me this brand and we narrowed down that this would be great for my dry skin especially in the dry california winter. After a month of using this all i can say is WOW! It lays under my makeup so beautifully and has helped my skin look plump and hydrated and i havent gotten any dry patches like i typically do this time of year. I notice that my makeup wears better throughout the day and i can use less makeup since my skin looks great! I can even wear powder(charlotte tilbury pressed powder & pat mcgrath pink under eye powder) without looking cakey! My AM/PM skin care routine in order: mario bedescu rose water spray, Peach & Lily super oasis serum, peach & lily retinoic eye cream, cerave PM facial lotion, josie maran argan oil (only a little during AM, more in PM), beauty of joseon sun screen
Love it for my daily morning skincare. Non irritating on my sensitive skin.

I love a product that does what it says it'll do. I mainly use this product at night, and I've noticed plump skin when I wake up the next day. It keeps my skin looking happy and hydrated, even though the winter air here in my hometown is really dry. I think it carries over to the day. There's been less flaking.

I am 59 and this is an HONEST Review. Reading through all the wonderful raves on this and also the spokes person for this line in Ulta mentioned how this would be good for my dry skin. I live in California where it is very dry so my skin need moisture! After applying this serum which felt nice but this serum sat on top of my skin, this did not absorb into my skin & felt very Tacky and Sticky for hours never absorb hours later! my skincare routine is,cleanse, exfoliate, tone, serum and moisturize.I take excellent care of my skin and it shows, But I would not recommend this product unless you like a film on your skin that leaves it Tacky! .

avis.titre: Like a refreshing drink of water for your skin
avis.texte: This isn't a flashy serum that's trending on social media (as far as I know!) but my skin loves it. It's like a calm, cool drink of water if you have dry skin. I'm 50+, living in a dry climate, and have been so disappointed with many skin care companies' products in that they don't do what's promised or they go bad quickly. I'm gradually switching all my skin care to Peach & Lily because I love what I've tried so much. If you want a dose of moisture in between your toner and moisturizer, give this serum a try!
This stuff is so delicious for your face skin! It seems to hydrate and moisturize without leaving it sticky or anything like that. Great texture. And it's like a nourishing layer on top.

I've been using the P & L Glass Skin Refining Serum for a couple of years, and it's been a huge help to my routine. My skin is much more hydrated which has lead to a calming of my acne (in addition to retinol and regular exfoliating)
My favorite serum that is perfect in every way. I liked how it felt on my skin right away. My face feels soft and hydrated for a smooth clear skin. Will always have as my daily ritual.
This serum is super hydrating. Leaves my skin soft and supple. It glides on easily and my skin looks radiant and glowy

I started exclusively using this line a month ago because my 55 year old, extremely dry skin was in need of a change. I have always used really good skin care but I think changing up your routine is important. I purchased this serum, as well as a few others in the line and their Matcha cream and my skin has been transformed. It's so soft and looks and feels so much better. The best part is the price point is very reasonable. I highly recommend.

I bought this right when it came out. I since ran out and have been using other hylauronic acid. I am purchasing another bottle because this stuff was so delicious when i was using it and now i miss it.
Love this serum, I use it with the copper peptide pro firming serum, and I can see a big difference. Reordered a second time, it's hydrating without being oily.
I pair this serum with the moisturizer and my skin has been so dewy and bouncy without being greasy or sticky. I loved it so much I repurchased.

This is my new holy grail from P&L! I have oily skin and didn't really know if my skin was dehydrated or not, but this plumps it up so much. It's full of antioxidants and is easy to fit into your routine.

I am a flight attendant and work in the arid conditions of the plane. I'm always looking for ways to add more moisture to my skin. The Super Oasis Serum has become a holy grail product for me. It is my absolute favorite product that Peach and Lily makes. I put this on before my moisturizer and it keeps my skin visibly hydrated. It's great for wearing on the dry, dry plane and also overnight. I put in around my eyes as well to super-charge the moisture in that delicate area. I highly recommend this serum if you have dry skin.

Absolutely love this serum, my skin drinks it up! It's the first thing I put on my skin and I've noticed a difference in how much less my skin gets irritated or red. I then use my actives to minimize irritation and this definitely helps!

I wanted to try this and I haven't had any issues with it. The texture is thick and it reminds me of the Glass Skin Water Gel Moisturizer. I have only used this in Summer so far and it does make my skin soft enough and supple and the product feels luxurious. In summer, I wont always use a Moisturizer after using the Super Oaisis Concentrated Serum, I will go straight to Sunscreen after this step. I really like this product.

This serum is so hydrating and makes my skin shine and feel so nice. It truly does what it says by delivering so much hydration and making your skin look dewy and supple. I use it am and pm. Your skin feels amazing afterwards. I have very sensitive, dry and sometimes combination skin. No breakouts or irritation or allergic reaction! P&L products have always been great for my sensitive skin.

This serum feels silky and light and spreads like a dream! It sinks it and layers well with my other products. It definitely provides a buffer of hydration for some of the harsher acids and acne products I use. No burning or tingling, just a light cooling and calming sensation.

avis.titre: Better than the glass skin serum!
avis.texte: Wonderful! I like it even better than the glass serum although that is a good product, this one is better! More hydrating for mature skin

avis.titre: A tall glass of water for my skin!
avis.texte: Let me just start by saying this stuff makes my skin feel like it just drank a gallon of water! So hydrating! Makes everything feel smoother!
Has changed my skin for the better. Days of flaky skin by the afternoon are over. I wish it wasn't so expensive. I do really love it!
I was having dry patches and this is definitely moisturizing, especially when paired with my other Peach & Lilly products
I can feel the difference in terms of hydration. Does not irritate my skin.
On my second bottle of this serum. I absolutely love this and the way it makes my skin feel

This is JUST the serum I've been looking for to solve my dry skin problems during the winter (and now summer too)! It works exactly as advertised. I use it every 4 days or so, and my skin stays hydrated and soft for the entire time until I use it again. I use it with the rest of the Glass Skin Kit, & it gives my skin an extra boost of moisture & hydration. :grin: I definitely recommend this product to anyone looking into P&L (and just the company in general).
Hydration powerhouse, love the polyglutamic acid. Keeps my skin looking vibrant and hydrated the entire day. I've noticed a softening of my crows feet when used under my reusable eye patches.

This stuff is incredible! I don't like heavy face creams but my skin gets dry so my fix is a super hydrating serum + a hydrating gel moisturizer and together makes my skin feel and look amazing! Smoothed, calm from redness, soft. This serum is thicker than Glass Skin more like a gel. I use 2-3 pumps for my face and neck and massage it in. While it dries down it may feel a bit tacky, just let it do it's thing or apply your moisturizer immediately after and then it's GLOW TIME!

It was very hydrating and went into my routine nicely. However, I definitely think it's overpriced and it did break me out so I cannot continue to use it. I would only recommend giving it a try if you don't mind paying that much for a nice hydration product and you're not prone to breakouts.
This serum is incredible. Leaves my skin plump and hydrated in combination with the glass skin veil mist. Love this brand so much and refer it to my friends all the time!

avis.titre: Wow this is a must have
avis.texte: I have been using peach and lily face wash and mousturizers for the past year, and i have also tried the glass skin serum but always felt like my skin was just not quite as moisturized as i would like despite looking great. Recently i added in a serum from another brand and it has been doing wonders but my skin still felt dry. I bought this yesterday and used it after my other serum and before my moisturizer and all i can say is wow. I woke up this morning to my skin feel so smooth and moisturized but not greasy. It was wxactly what my akin routine was missing. I would totally recommend it.

Amazing product. I had an allergic reaction to a different face wash and my face was dry as sandpaper. I was applying moisturizer every 30 minutes and then I tried this and 3x a day was all I needed. It totally healed my skin. Iv been using daily ever since to stay hydrated.
I've been dealing with much drier skin than usual but this has helped to smooth and hydrate my skin without causing any irritation or breakouts.
i love this product and its part of my daily regimen! definitely makes my skin glow!
Wonderful companion to the original P&L serum. I have dry skin and this works exceptionally well as my night serum

I went into Ulta looking for a fragrance free mosturizer because I've been having serverly dry , itchy ,burning , peeling eye lids. I was terrified to buy something that would burn them more so I circled for a while until an associate asked me if I needed help . I told her what I was looking for ans she reccomended this .. I was afraid she was just trying to get commission but boy was I wrong.. This stuff is incredible ! 2 days after using my eye lids are back to normal and my skin is glowing like it never has, I am truley astonished . I also have sensitive skin and this has been the perfect solution!! BUYY ITT

I went into Ulta looking for a fragrance free mosturizer because I've been having serverly dry , itchy ,burning , peeling eye lids. I was terrified to buy something that would burn them more so I circled for a while until an associate asked me if I needed help . I told her what I was looking for ans she reccomended this .. I was afraid she was just trying to get commission but boy was I wrong.. This stuff is incredible ! 2 days after using my eye lids are back to normal and my skin is glowing like it never has, I am truley astonished . I also have sensitive skin and this has been the perfect solution!! BUYY ITT

avis.titre: I love my Peach & Lily products but this one wasn't one of m
avis.texte: I initially got this for my Mom because she said her skin felt a little dry. She didn't like it so I gave it a try. I felt like my wrinkles were more prominent when I woke up in the morning. It does leave your skin feeling soft though. I think it'd be perfect for someone younger.

avis.titre: My skin is in LOVE with this serum!
avis.texte: I was having trouble getting my skin back to its normal moisture levels after such a dry winter and decided to try P&L's Super Oasis serum for some much needed help. Soooo happy I did, my skin immediately responded after first use! I've been using the serum daily both in the morning and before bed followed by my am and pm moisturizers for about 3 weeks now and my skin feels so amazing! So full and hydrated like it used to feel but BETTER. This serum is now a key staple in my daily regimen, I am so grateful for P&L to have made this product, it's become such a dream for my skin!!
This serum has a touch more weight to it than most but leaves my skin feeling bouncier. Absorbs very nicely and layers well.
If you have dry skin then this serum is FOR YOU! Its super hydrating and has a thicker almost gel-like texture. My skin has never felt so smooth and relaxed, with absolutely no dryness!

My skin was suffering this past winter a lot, it's been more dry than ever but after trying this brand's products and especially this serum, I have not had any problems at all. My skin is moisturized and happy. I love this serum and use it nightly while using the Glass Skin serum in the morning, following both with a moisturizer and sometimes their oil as well. Highly recommend if you have very dry skin that needs help.

avis.titre: Best Product I've used for my rosacea
avis.texte: I have very sensitive, combo skin. I have an oily T-zone and dry cheeks where my rosacea is at it's worse. I'm always red and itchy in my cheeks. I've tried other hyaluronic serums before and typically they actually irritate my rosacea. I bought this on a whim thinking it would be the same story but it's not. My redness is almost none existent and no more itching. I don't even have to wear a moisturizer over it. It's amazing

I have very dry sensitive skin. From fall to summer it is tight, painful, and will even flake and crack. I have had some degree of pain on my face since October and it is now April. I went into ultra desperate for something that would help my dry painful skin that also was burnt from retinol. I was shown this as well as the peptide moisturizer. Within a few hours the pain was gone! Within 3 hours there was a visible difference in my skin and by the next morning it was a 180 degree turn around! It has been three days and each day I feel my fine lines and wrinkles are less viable swell as the redness and flaking are completely gone. I am a lifetime user now! I look forward to trying some of their other products as well.
